description: This is a web-based user interface for visualizing and navigating PostgreSQL database schemas and data tables. It allows users to select databases, view tables, and inspect table data with dynamic fetching, rendering, and interaction features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles user interactions to expand or collapse a database's tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table in the database.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data with interactive cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cells, handling long strings, objects, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for detailed viewing.
